Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

OUR VALUES

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

  • Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

  • Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

  • Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

  • Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

  • Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

  • Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

  • Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

  • Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

  • Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

  • Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

  • Annual bonus potential

  • Health benefits effective on start date

  • Ability to help build a market leader in value-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Preferred:

description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

  1. Online assessment or practical task

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. \n

  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.

  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.

title: Team Lead Education
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

This is what you’ve got

Over the past years, we’ve also built one of the fastest-growing SEO businesses in our space, partnering with some of the world’s largest publishers. Beyond our own sites, We Love X constantly incubates new, performance-marketing-driven business models – from first idea to international scale.

title: Werkstudent Wirtschaftsinformatik (m/w/d)
description:
Wir stellen uns dir vor.

Eine Kanzlei, vielschichtige Leistungsbereiche und über 45 Teammitglieder. Was wie eine klassische mittelständische Steuerberatungs- und Rechtsanwaltsgesellschaft klingen mag, ist bei genauerem Betrachten vielleicht doch etwas mehr. Wir sehen den Menschen vor den Zahlen, denken und handeln fortschrittlich und arbeiten kontinuierlich daran, uns als Kanzlei und Arbeitgeber sinnvoll weiterzuentwickeln.

Dass wir dafür auch einen Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) suchen, mag für eine Steuerkanzlei zunächst ungewöhnlich erscheinen. Für uns ist es allerdings der nächste logische Schritt. Schließlich möchten wir die Digitalisierung unserer Kanzlei aktiv vorantreiben, bestehende Prozesse verbessern und neue technische Möglichkeiten im Bereich KI sinnvoll in unseren Arbeitsalltag integrieren.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, digitale Anwendungen weiterzuentwickeln und eigene Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Natürlich sind auch wir nicht perfekt. Wir geben jedoch jeden Tag unser Bestes, um für dich einen optimalen Arbeitsort zu schaffen.

Dein individuelles Tätigkeitsprofil.

Du interessierst dich für IT und möchtest mit deiner Arbeit tatsächlich etwas bewegen? Bei uns kannst du die technische Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Kanzlei aktiv mitgestalten und dafür sorgen, dass digitale Anwendungen im Arbeitsalltag reibungslos funktionieren. Dabei kümmerst du dich sowohl um unsere bestehende IT-Landschaft als auch um die Entwicklung neuer Lösungen, mit denen wir wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisieren und unsere Prozesse effizienter gestalten.

Konkret erwarten dich folgende Tätigkeitsbereiche:

  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne IT-Themen und Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeiter bei Anwendungsfragen

  • Koordination und Zusammenarbeit mit unserem externen IT-Dienstleister

  • Analyse, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung technischer Probleme

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung, insbesondere Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive

  • Einführung neuer Anwendungen sowie Dokumentation unserer IT-Systeme und Prozesse

  • Analyse und Optimierung manueller sowie wiederkehrender Geschäftsprozesse

  • Entwicklung und Betreuung automatisierter Workflows mit Power Automate

  • Erstellung kleiner interner Anwendungen mit Power Apps

  • Anbindung von Fachanwendungen über Schnittstellen wie REST-APIs, HTTP, JSON und Connectoren

  • Datenverarbeitung und -aufbereitung mit Excel und Power Query

Unsere Wünsche an dich.

Wir erwarten nicht, dass du bereits jedes Programm beherrschst oder mit sämtlichen Technologien gearbeitet hast. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis mitbringst, dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest und Freude daran hast, eigenständig Lösungen zu entwickeln. Schließlich verändert sich die IT-Welt ständig und wir möchten uns gemeinsam mit dir weiterentwickeln.

Von den folgenden Punkten solltest du dich ebenfalls angesprochen fühlen:

  • Du absolvierst aktuell ein Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder bist in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Systeme, digitale Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge

  • Microsoft 365 ist dir vertraut und idealerweise hast du dich bereits mit Power Automate, Power Apps oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen beschäftigt

  • Begriffe wie APIs, JSON oder Power Query sind dir bekannt und du hast Interesse daran, dein Wissen in diesen Bereichen zu vertiefen

  • Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, strukturiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung

  • Teamzusammenhalt ist dir wichtig und du hast Freude daran, andere Mitarbeiter bei technischen Fragen zu unterstützen

Das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

Ein Arbeitsverhältnis ist ein Geben und Nehmen. Deshalb kannst du dich bei uns auf weit mehr als ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis freuen:

  • Gelebte Flexibilität mit Home-Office und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • Mentale Gesundheitsförderung mit vielschichtigen Unterstützungsangeboten und zusätzlich bis zu 12 Coaching- oder Therapiestunden pro Jahr

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung durch einen engagierten Ansprechpartner

  • Regelmäßiges Feedback zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung

  • Klare Strukturen gepaart mit digitalen und standardisierten Prozessen

  • Vertrauen und Freiraum für ein eigenständiges Arbeiten

  • Weiterbildungsflatrate

  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit 50 Euro Sachbezugsgutscheinen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Kindergartenzuschuss, Bike-Leasing etc.

  • Business-Englisch und einmal pro Woche ein Fitnessangebot

  • Höhenverstellbare Tische und klimatisierte Räumlichkeiten

  • Beste technische Hard- und Software-Ausstattung (Notebook, Geschäftshandy etc.)

  • Support durch einen kompetenten externen IT-Systempartner

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und vieles mehr

Mit wenigen Klicks zum neuen Job.

Wir gehen auch beim Bewerbungsprozess neue Wege. Bewirb dich mit nur wenigen Klicks über unser digitales Bewerbungsformular bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Wir sind NETSHAKE – die AI-First E-Commerce-Agentur

Als Shopify Premier Partner und eine der führenden AI-First-Agenturen Europas vereinen wir fundiertes E-Commerce-Know-how mit künstlicher Intelligenz. Unser Ziel: bessere Ergebnisse, kürzere Umsetzungszeiten und maximaler Output.

Deine Rolle: Shopify & AI Traffic

Als (Junior) E-Commerce Kaufmann bringst du Shopify und AI Traffic zusammen. Du entwickelst Shops weiter, setzt Optimierungen um und arbeitest daran, dass sie bei Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini gefunden und empfohlen werden.

Für deine Kunden bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson: Du leitest Workshops, legst gemeinsam mit ihnen Ziele fest und steuerst die Umsetzung deiner Projekte eigenverantwortlich. Dein Teamlead setzt den Rahmen – du sorgst dafür, dass aus Zielen Ergebnisse werden.

Unsere DNA: AI First

AI ist bei NETSHAKE keine Ergänzung, sondern die Grundlage unserer Arbeitsweise. Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, automatisieren gezielt und fördern den Ausbau deiner AI-Kompetenz. Unsere Überzeugung: Wer AI souverän einsetzt, macht sich nicht überflüssig, sondern unverzichtbar.

Du möchtest Verantwortung tragen, dich schnell weiterentwickeln und den E-Commerce von morgen mitgestalten? Dann werde Teil von NETSHAKE!

Aufgaben

🛍️ Shopify-Umsetzung

  • Du realisierst Shopify-Shops von der ersten Konzeption bis zum Go-live. Theme-Architektur, Liquid, App-Integrationen und Shopify Functions setzt du selbstständig um.

  • Du unterstützt Händler bei Fragen zu Shop-Struktur, Funktionen und technischen Entscheidungen – verständlich, transparent und mit Blick auf die passende Lösung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den Erfolg des gesamten Projekts, nicht nur für einzelne Aufgaben.

🔎 GEO & KI-Sichtbarkeit

  • Du bringst GEO-Strategien in die Umsetzung: Mit strukturierten Daten, Schema Markup, Feeds und optimierten Inhalten schaffst du die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass Kundenshops in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Co. als relevante Quellen erkannt und empfohlen werden.

  • Du analysierst Shops mit Blick auf ihre KI-Sichtbarkeit und entwickelst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du überprüfst Ergebnisse, testest neue Ansätze und optimierst kontinuierlich – auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

✍️ Content & Lifecycle

  • Du entwickelst Inhalte, die sowohl für klassische Suchmaschinen als auch für generative KI-Systeme optimiert sind.

  • Du betreust den gesamten Content-Lifecycle deiner Kundenprojekte: von der Erstellung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zum Monitoring.

  • Du erstellst monatliche Performance-Reportings und leitest daraus klare nächste Schritte ab.

⚙️ AI-Tools & Automation

  • Du integrierst AI konsequent in deinen Arbeitsalltag – von Recherche und Shop-Umsetzung über Content und Datenanalyse bis zu Qualitätssicherung und Reporting.

  • Du entwickelst AI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen, die wiederkehrende Aufgaben reduzieren und den Output steigern.

  • Du probierst eigenständig neue AI-Technologien aus und bringst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten ins Team ein.

🤝 Händler & Workshops

  • Du planst und leitest Händler-Workshops mit einem klaren Fokus auf messbare Projektergebnisse.

  • Du hältst Kunden und Team proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, sodass der aktuelle Projektstand jederzeit klar ist.

  • Nach jedem Projektabschluss holst du zwei Bewertungen ein – eine auf Shopify und eine auf Google. Dein Qualitätsanspruch: fünf Sterne.

Qualifikation

🎯 Ownership

Du übernimmst Verantwortung – für deine Aufgaben, das gesamte Projektergebnis und den gemeinsamen Teamerfolg. Wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft, konzentrierst du dich auf Lösungen statt auf Schuldzuweisungen.

⚡ Eigenverantwortung

Du erhältst ein Ziel und organisierst selbstständig den Weg dorthin. Du planst deine Sprints, behältst Fristen im Blick und kommunizierst Risiken rechtzeitig. Du wartest nicht darauf, angeschoben zu werden, sondern treibst deine Projekte selbst voran.

💡 Weitblick

Du denkst über einzelne Aufgaben hinaus, erkennst mögliche Probleme früh und entdeckst Verbesserungspotenzial in Abläufen. Statt nur Fragen aufzuwerfen, bringst du durchdachte Optionen und eine begründete Empfehlung mit. Bestehende Prozesse hinterfragst du konstruktiv – und entwickelst bessere Alternativen.

🤖 AI-Kompetenz

AI ist für dich mehr als ein hilfreiches Werkzeug: Sie prägt deine Herangehensweise. Du kennst ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity und Cursor und kannst einschätzen, welches Tool für welche Aufgabe den größten Nutzen bietet. Neue Tools und Claude Skills entdeckst und testest du eigenständig und zeigst dem Team, wie sie sich direkt sinnvoll einsetzen lassen. Du verknüpfst Tools, APIs und KI zu neuen Lösungen.

Außerdem bringst du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch mit: Du gibst dich nicht damit zufrieden, dass etwas lediglich funktioniert, sondern möchtest wirklich gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Du nimmst Feedback offen an, lernst schnell und probierst Neues aus. Auf deine Zusagen ist Verlass – und wenn etwas dazwischenkommt, kommunizierst du das frühzeitig.

Must-haves

  • 🛍️ Shopify-Expertise: Du hast nachweislich Shopify-Shops für echte Händler aufgebaut und betreut. Mit Themes, Liquid und App-Integrationen arbeitest du sicher.

  • 📈 Content & Marketing: Du bringst Erfahrung in Content-Strategie, SEO oder digitalem Marketing mit – idealerweise mit messbaren Erfolgen.

  • 🔎 AI Search & GEO: Du kennst dich sehr gut mit ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und Claude aus und verstehst, wie E-Commerce-Marken in KI-Such- und Antwortsystemen sichtbar werden.

  • ⚙️ AI Automation: Du hast bereits mit n8n, Make, Zapier, Custom GPTs oder vergleichbaren Lösungen gearbeitet.

  • 💻 Technisches Verständnis: Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, strukturierten Daten und Feeds.

  • 🎤 Kundenkommunikation: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Kundenworkshops durchzuführen und zu moderieren.

  • 🇩🇪 Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du drückst dich schriftlich wie mündlich klar, sicher und einwandfrei aus.

  • 🚀 Hands-on-Mentalität: Du möchtest nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern selbst umsetzen, Verantwortung übernehmen und Ergebnisse erzielen.

Benefits – warum NETSHAKE?

🤖 AI First – Wissen, das dich weiterbringt

Du arbeitest mit Premium-AI-Tools und vertiefst dein Wissen in regelmäßigen Trainings und Deep-Dives zu aktuellen Modellen, GEO-Techniken und AI-Workflows. Dabei geht es immer um die praktische Anwendung: mehr Output in weniger Zeit.

🚀 Entwicklung nach Leistung statt Betriebszugehörigkeit

Vom Rookie über den Expert bis zum Senior Expert: Wie schnell du dich entwickelst, hängt von deinen Fähigkeiten, deinen Ergebnissen und deinem Beitrag zur Teamkultur ab – nicht von festgelegten Wartezeiten.

💸 Performance-Bonus ohne Obergrenze

Dich erwartet ein attraktives Grundgehalt mit einem ungedeckelten Bonus. Grundlage ist unser NETSHAKE Performance Framework, mit dem wir deine Leistung quartalsweise in den Bereichen Output, Skills & Culture bewerten. Wer kontinuierlich überzeugt, kann entsprechend wachsen.

🎯 Verantwortung von Anfang an

Du betreust eigene Händler, steuerst eigene Projekte und triffst echte Entscheidungen. Dafür bekommst du Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Abstimmungswege und direktes Feedback – innerhalb von Stunden statt Wochen.

📚 Lernen aus 26 Jahren E-Commerce-Erfahrung

Mehr als 1.600 Projekte und Einblicke in unterschiedlichste Wachstumsphasen bilden die Basis unseres Wissens. Du lernst von erfahrenen Profis, erhältst intensive Schulungen zu Shopify, E-Commerce und AI und entwickelst dich fachlich wie persönlich weiter.

🤝 Gemeinsam besser werden

Deine Ideen sind willkommen. Wir unterstützen Eigeninitiative, testen neue Ansätze, teilen unser Wissen und helfen einander weiter. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach Aufgaben ab, sondern gestaltest NETSHAKE aktiv mit.

🌍 Remote arbeiten oder ins Office nach Dubai

Du kannst remote arbeiten oder unser modernes Büro im Herzen von Business Bay nutzen. Du entscheidest, an welchem Ort du am produktivsten bist.

Bereit für deinen nächsten Schritt?

Wichtig ist uns dabei: Diese Rolle passt zu Menschen, die sich einbringen und etwas bewegen möchten. Wir suchen Eigenverantwortung, Engagement, Begeisterung für AI und den Antrieb, sich in einem leistungsstarken, zukunftsorientierten Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the Role:

Cohere seeks a high-performing Talent Coordinator, eager to take on a new challenge here in our Talent Operations team at Cohere. You will schedule a high volume of roles as a member of a small but mighty coordination team, who partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure interviews are arranged in a timely manner and that candidates have an excellent experience interviewing at Cohere. If you consider yourself highly organised, collaborative and someone who goes above and beyond to ensure excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

In this role you will be a liaison between teams supporting hiring managers, the Talent Team, the People team, and many more. Our Talent Coordinators are a primary internal and external point of contact and are a core part of our TA function supporting the scaling of Cohere. The team is not a behind the scenes support function, they are the beating heart of the Cohere Talent team.

You will schedule a high volume of interviews diligently and efficiently, manage a world class candidate experience, build strong and strategic relationships, manage multiple calendars and own the interview process with seamless communication and ownership from start to finish.

Our ATS is Ashby and we utilise the Advanced Scheduling functionality!

Candidates must be based in Germany to be considered for this opportunity.

As a Talent Coordinator, you will:

  • Schedule a large volume of interviews, ensuring our hiring teams and candidates are supported via seamless communication

  • Manage the candidate experience and build strong relationships across the organisation

  • Partner closely with a team of Executive Assistants, Hiring Managers and Recruiters

  • Support and optimize our interview processes & increase efficiency/automate where possible

  • Provide status updates, answer questions, and ensure timely follow up for our recruiters and candidate

  • Support on TA Operations projects where required

  • Keep our internal documentation up to date, working with detail and organization to ensure scalability and operational efficiency

This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have:

  • 2+ years of professional work experience supporting a fast paced recruitment team

  • Experience scheduling a high volume of interviews, managing multiple calendars, and supporting a large volume of interviews with hiring managers and executive teams

  • Attention to detail coupled with the ability manage a high workload at a demanding pace

  • A team player "can-do" attitude and a proven track record of partnering with all functions and levels across an enterprise

  • Possess very strong time management & communication skills

  • Track record of executing on tasks for high-touch recruitment initiatives thoughtfully and efficiently at a fast pace

  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with tact and discretion

  • Have a genuine passion for providing excellent candidate experiences

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

ElevenLabs is looking for a Head of Strategic Pursuits to lead our largest, most complex and most transformational enterprise deals around the world, from first executive conversation through signature and into deployment.

This is a global leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. Strategic Pursuits is not traditional sales support. It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done.

You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. The AE continues to own the account and the relationship. Your job is to make sure we win the deal and that it's structured to set us and the customer up for long-term success.

The work doesn't stop at one deal. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered.

This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function.

In this role you will

  • Lead strategic deals. Own the pursuit strategy for our largest and most complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with account teams from qualification through close. Help decide which pursuits warrant this level of investment and where your time goes.

  • Build executive engagement. Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Bring together Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and executive sponsors to accelerate deal progression and remove blockers. Run the pursuit like a program, with a clear plan, owners, and a cadence, without becoming the bottleneck.

  • Structure and win complex transactions. Drive competitive strategy, solution design, commercial models, negotiations, and creative deal structures (multi-year commitments, partnerships, co-development, platform and marketplace models, and others we haven't invented yet) to secure transformational agreements that are good for the customer and for ElevenLabs.

  • Work across senior stakeholders on both sides. Navigate complex buying committees, procurement, legal, and in some cases boards and investors, and keep the deal moving when it gets stuck at the top.

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

💡 👉 Hinweis: Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung.

WAS DU MACHST

  • Du entwickelst und implementierst strategische Social Media Konzepte

  • Du steuerst eigenverantwortlich alle Phasen des Social Media Managements – von der strategischen Planung über die Content-Produktion bis zur Community-Betreuung

  • Du fungierst als dedicated Ansprechperson für das Kundenteam, berätst proaktiv zu Social Media Trends und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für verschiedene Zielgruppen

  • Du verantwortest die Entwicklung innovativer Social Media Kampagnen für Kunden-Produkte – von der Redaktionsplanung über Content Creation bis zur Performance-Optimierung

  • Du identifizierst Trends, testest neue Formate und setzt innovative Ansätze zur Steigerung von Brand Awareness und Engagement um

  • Du erstellst detaillierte Performance-Reportings , analysierst KPIs im Kontext und präsentierst Optimierungspotenziale sowie Marktinsights überzeugend

  • Du entwickelst aus Kunden- und Community-Feedback kontinuierlich neue Ideen für die Markenführung und verbesserst die Social Media Performance nachhaltig

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Kundenteam sowie internen Fachbereichen zusammen, um integrierte Kampagnen erfolgreich umzusetzen 

  • Du unterstützt Junior-Kolleg:innen bei der Betreuung von Projekten und förderst den Wissenstransfer zu spezifischen Social Media Strategien


WAS DU BRAUCHST

  • Du verfügst über mindestens fünf Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Social Media Management und hast dabei unterschiedlichste Marken und Projekte erfolgreich begleitet

  • Du bist auf TikTok spezialisiert, kennst die Besonderheiten der Plattform, ihre Community sowie die relevanten Content-Formate. Auch im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook, Instagram, Business Suite) bewegst du dich sicher und setzt kanalübergreifende Strategien souverän um

  • Du glänzt mit Erfahrung in der Kundenkommunikation, trittst jederzeit professionell auf und überzeugst Kund:innen mit deiner empathischen und lösungsorientierten Beratung

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für aktuelle Entwicklungen und Trends im Social Media Bereich, erkennst frühzeitig Chancen und setzt diese kreativ und zielgerichtet für unsere Kund:innen ein

  • Du zeichnest dich durch hohe Eigenmotivation und Lernbereitschaft aus, strukturierst dich und deine Aufgaben selbstständig und behältst auch in dynamischen Phasen stets den Überblick

  • Du denkst strategisch und analytisch, entwickelst nachhaltige Wachstumsstrategien und triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Analysen und Reportings sind für dich essenzielles Handwerkszeug, um Erfolge zu messen und Maßnahmen weiterzuentwickeln

  • Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen und baust durch deine offene, verbindliche Art langfristige und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf

  • Du bist mit den gängigen Social Media Tools bestens vertraut und nutzt sie effizient zur Planung, Umsetzung und Auswertung deiner Aktivitäten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Onboarding & Support

    No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns.

  • Erstklassige Ausstattung

    Can’t work without my iPhone. Mit MacBook, iPhone und aktueller Apple-Tech arbeitest du flexibel und effizient. Das gilt für unsere Altbau-Offices genauso wie zuhause oder unterwegs.

  • Wachstum & Weiterentwicklung

    Rise & shine, darling! Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget gibt dir die Freiheit, in Workshops, Seminare, zertifizierte Kurse oder Coachings zu investieren. So entwickelst du dich genau in die Richtung, die zu deinen Zielen passt.

  • Flexibel arbeiten

    „Ob das bei euch gerade genauso ist? I doubt it!” Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du innerhalb der EU remote arbeiten. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle machen es leicht, Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Bei einem Umzug oder in besonderen Lebenssituationen wie einem Trauerfall erhältst du zusätzliche freie Tage.

  • Mehr Freizeit

    „It’s my birthday, I’mma spend my money.“ An deinem Geburtstag heißt es: Laptop zu und genießen. Zusätzlich sind der 24. Dezember und der 31. Dezember frei. Jubiläen und Geburtstage feiern wir mit kleinen Überraschungen.

  • Health & Wellbeing

    Hot girl walk or heavy lift? Mit der Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft entscheidest du selbst, ob Yoga, Pilates, Schwimmen oder Krafttraining zu deinem Glow Up passt. nilo.health sorgt für mentale Stärke und bietet Sessions mit Psycholog:innen oder Coaches. Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen.

  • Exklusive Deals & Extras

    It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen:

  • Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst.

  • Mobiko – 65 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget, nutzbar für Deutschlandticket, Tankkosten und alles, was kostet, um von A nach B zu kommen.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – 50 € monatlicher Zuschuss zu deiner betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

Außerdem sind unsere Offices dog-friendly. Snacks, Obst und Drinks stehen allen Mates jederzeit kostenlos zur Verfügung.
