title: Werkstudent:in Business Consultancy
description:
Über Northwave

Unternehmen zu schützen, ist unsere Mission.

Bei Northwave verändern 275+ Cyber Security-Spezialist:innen die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen und Organisationen digitale Sicherheit denken und umsetzen. Mit unserem Hauptsitz in Utrecht, unserem DACH-Headquarter in Leipzig sowie Standorten in Österreich, Schweden und Belgien sind wir europaweit vertreten.

Northwave verbindet Expertise im Ethical Hacking mit Erkenntnissen aus der Verhaltenspsychologie und modernstem Security Management auf höchstem Niveau. Wir reagieren nicht nur auf Bedrohungen, sondern erkennen sie frühzeitig. Mit unseren 24/7 Managed Security Services und maßgeschneiderten Lösungen begleiten wir unsere Kund:innen auf ihrem individuellen Weg zu mehr Sicherheit.

Wenn Du Teil von Northwave wirst, arbeitest Du in einem Umfeld, in dem Innovation zu echten Ergebnissen führt. Bei uns entwickelst Du Deine Expertise weiter und trägst aktiv dazu bei, die Zukunft der digitalen Sicherheit in unterschiedlichsten Branchen mitzugestalten.

Deine Mission

Du willst nicht einfach nur Akten wälzen, sondern die echte Welt der strategischen Management- und IT-Beratung hautnah kennenlernen? Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) in unserem Business Security Consulting Team arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Head of Consultancy DACH zusammen. 

Deine Mission ist es, die Brücke zwischen strategischen Geschäftszielen und den Herausforderungen der Cybersecurity zu schlagen. Du musst an Tag 1 kein technischer Deep-Dive-Experte sein – was für uns zählt, ist dein Drive, dein analytischer Verstand und dein Verständnis für Geschäftsmodelle. 

Deine Aufgaben: 

  • Sparringspartner in Training: Du unterstützt den Head of Consultancy direkt im strategischen Tagesgeschäft und bei der Steuerung des DACH-Beratungsgeschäfts. 

  • Consulting hautnah: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte in den Bereichen Cybersecurity-Strategie, Risikomanagement und Compliance (z.B. NIS2, CRA, ISO 27001) und lernst das Handwerkszeug der Top-Beratung von der Pike auf. 

  • Business & Cyber: Du analysierst Geschäftsmodelle, bereitest Marktrecherchen auf und hilfst dabei, abstrakte Bedrohungen in pragmatische, wertschöpfende Strategien für das C-Level zu übersetzen. 

  • Content Creation: Du erstellst Management-Präsentationen, Reports und Workshop-Materialien, die komplexe Sachverhalte auf den Punkt bringen. 

Das erwartet Dich bei uns

  • Das Wichtigste zuerst: Dein Studium steht an erster Stelle. Daher findet die Abstimmung deiner Arbeitszeiten immer im Austausch mit dir und unter Berücksichtigung deines Semesterplans statt. Zudem bieten wir dir einen attraktiven Stundenlohn (über Mindestlohn) und sechs Wochen Urlaub im Jahr.

  • Unser Büro ist mit Apple Geräten, höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und einem stets mit kühlen Getränkengefüllten Kühlschrank ausgestattet.  Ach ja, und es gibt regelmäßig Merch im Northwave Design, sowie Kuchenund niederländische Karamellwaffeln.

  • Bei Northwave bist du Teil eines internationalen Teams aus Security-Enthusiat:innen, die gerne ihr Wissen teilen und sich über Unterstützung z.B. beim Firmenlauf oder dem Pub Quiz freuen. In Deutschland befinden wir uns noch im Aufbau - deine Chance also, mitzugestalten.


  • Lust auf Beratung: Du hast den absoluten Willen, die Consulting-Welt zu erobern und bist bereit, dich mit Hands-on-Mentalität in neue, komplexe Themenstellungen einzuarbeiten. 

  • Mindset & Drive: Begeisterungsfähigkeit, grenzenlose Neugier und ein extrem hoher Lernwille sind für dich selbstverständlich. 

  • Business First: Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes betriebswirtschaftliches Denken. Ein echtes Interesse für Cybersecurity ist Pflicht – genauso wichtig ist aber das Verständnis dafür, dass IT-Sicherheit immer auch einen "Business Value" liefern muss. 

  • Background: Eingeschrieben an einer Hochschule? Check. Was genau du studierst (von Kunstgeschichte bis Informatik), ist uns dabei völlig egal. Wir suchen keine reinen Theorie-Experten, sondern Macher mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem messerscharfen Verstand. 

  • Skills: Du bringst eine strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit. 

  • Perspektive: Du wirst Teil eines internationalen Teams von Cybersecurity-Enthusiasten. Da unsere deutsche Organisation kontinuierlich wächst, hast du die einmalige Chance, unsere Zukunft mitzugestalten und dich langfristig bei uns weiterzuentwickeln. 

     

Interessiert?

Du bist Dir noch nicht ganz sicher? Dann schau Dir an, wie das Arbeiten bei Northwave aussieht: Karriere bei Northwave.

Wenn Du bereit bist, mit uns die digitale Zukunft sicherer zu machen, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager DevOps (GCP/Kubernetes)
description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

  • In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings.

  • Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft.

  • Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab.

  • Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen.

  • Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

  • Customer ownership, end to end. After the contract is signed, the customer is yours: kickoff, rollout plan, training, go-live and everything after. Nobody looks over your shoulder, and your customers’ success is on you.

  • 5–6 enterprise customers in parallel. At 9am you present to a Fortune 500 CPO, at 10 you go through approval workflows with their operational team, at 11 you tell an IT director why his timeline won’t work.

  • Succeed as a team. You work shoulder to shoulder with our Forward Deployed Engineers. You own the customer, the plan and the “why”. They build the integrations and the product. Together you ship value fast.

  • We’re in the office five days a week.

  • The drive to grow beyond your role. You don’t just implement: you drive expansion, genuinely care about your customers’ satisfaction, and do something about what’s missing, at the customer or at Lio.

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Y Combinator, with a $30M Series A and offices in Munich and New York. We’re winning, and every employee is a shareholder, so you win with us. You’ll work with some of the smartest, most driven and unconventional people in Europe, and no two weeks look the same.

On top of that, you get a brand-new office at Stiglmaierplatz, catered dinners, a subsidized Wellpass or Deutschlandticket, team events like Wiesn, parties to celebrate our wins, 30 days of vacation, and the latest equipment.

Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

We are seeking a Treasury and Payments Associate to join our motivated team of experts who value innovation, excellence, and shared growth in a results-driven environment. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the seamless flow of day-to-day operations by managing our treasury, payments, and reconciliation processes.

What you will do:

  • Timely processing and reconciliation of all inbound and outbound payments and treasury processes, ensuring accuracy and efficiency

  • Managing customer payments and monitoring all related transactions to support smooth and reliable cash flows

  • Preparing and distributing cash & securities reconciliation reports to management, providing timely and accurate insights into our cash and securities holdings

  • Conducting cash forecasts and offering insights on liquidity management strategies to optimize cash flows

  • Investigating and resolving any discrepancies between internal cash records and external statements

  • Proper monitoring of the operations bank accounts ensuring that balances are supported at all times.

  • Providing support for customer queries, audit processes, and ensuring smooth communication with banking partners

  • Championing process improvements and automation projects, collaborating with product and engineering teams to enhance our treasury and payments infrastructure

  • Ensuring full compliance with all applicable laws and regulations in the payments landscape.

What you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field

  • At least 2 years of relevant work experience with a focus on Treasury, Payments, Reconciliations or related fields

  • Very good understanding of the global payments space - Sepa, Target, UK payment flows, Swift cross border transfers, among others.

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills; ability to identify errors

  • Fluent in English - both written and verbal. German is a strong advantage

  • Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships with both internal and external stakeholders

  • Experience in data analysis and process automation using data visualization tools, SQL, Python, or similar is a plus

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

description:
Senior Talent Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000

Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire.

We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with.

Why this role exists now

Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace.

We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position.

The role

You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls.

Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer.

  • Partnering with hiring managers in every team: shaping briefs, setting expectations and balancing competing priorities.

  • Running structured interviews to a high bar, making confident calls on borderline candidates, and coaching hiring managers through the process.

  • Keeping candidates warm and informed through long, multi-stage processes, so no one ever goes dark.

  • Using AI, approved templates and Ashby automations to keep routine work fast, so switching between roles doesn't slow you down.

  • Building repeatable AI-assisted approaches (sourcing prompts, interview kits, funnel views) and sharing the useful ones with the team.

     
 

Who we're looking for

  • An experienced recruiter with deep, reliable expertise across the full recruitment lifecycle, and the curiosity to get up to speed quickly on any part of the business.

  • Experience recruiting across a wide range of functions at once, and switching context between very different roles without losing pace or quality.

  • Strong stakeholder partnering: you build trusted relationships with hiring managers, and have the credibility to influence and constructively challenge them with evidence, in writing and in the room, including pushing back on a brief without damaging the relationship.

  • Confident, consistent judgement of candidates whilst operating at pace. If you've worked through a period of growth you will feel right at home here.

  • An AI-native mindset: you don't just use AI tools, you re-engineer your own workflows with them, and you know where AI can be trusted and where judgement needs to take over.

  • Someone who shares what they know and helps develop the people around them.

 

Why you might not want to apply

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

  • If you want to specialise in one area. You'll be hiring across the whole organisation, often for very different roles in the same week. If you'd rather go deep in one function, this isn't the role for you.

  • If you want to move into people management now. This is an individual contributor role and you'll be carrying your own reqs. You'll informally mentor and share knowledge, but there are no direct reports.

  • If you're looking to own TA strategy or set standards for the whole team. Good ideas come from everyone in our team, but leading on this won’t be yours to own.

  • If you prefer a steer on ambiguous searches. We need someone who works through unclear briefs independently, and only escalates the genuinely strategic calls.

  • If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

  • If you're a brilliant solo recruiter but you don't share what works. Evidence of knowledge sharing from prior roles will be assessed during the interview process.

If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

You’ll own the product roadmap for Dex. That covers our candidate product, our client product, our internal tools and the ML systems behind all of them.

Our team moves fast. Your job is to point that speed at the right problems and keep a clear lookahead: what’s next, and what’s coming over the horizon.

Ideas at Dex come from design, engineering, our talent team, clients and candidates. You’ll pull them together, decide what matters most, and turn that into a plan we can deliver.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work closely with our founder, as well as across the whole business.

The divide between product managers and engineers has never been thinner, you’re excited by how AI is changing our roles and are excited to be part of how the products of the future are built.

You’re AI pilled, you run agents, you tinker and are excited about technology in general

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap. Our candidate product, client product, internal tools and the ML systems that power them are all connected. You'll own how they move forward together.

  • Partner with engineering and design. Work closely with our engineers and designers as the work gets done, from scoping through to shipping.

  • Build for our talent experts. Our internal talent experts are at the core of our business. Work alongside them to build a platform that makes them better at what they do.

  • Run delivery. Own our planning sessions and our roadmap in Linear. Make sure we have a plan, even if it might change, so we always know what’s next and roughly what’s after.

  • Do the analysis. Understand what we stand to gain from each piece of work in terms of metrics, set the hypothesis upfront, and work with the people doing the work to confirm or reject it.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong technical PM. You've worked in product at an early-stage company, and you were likely an engineer before that.

  • Delivery focused. You care deeply about moving fast and shipping.

  • Great with stakeholders. You're comfortable with candidates, clients and our internal recruitment team, and you keep all three at the heart of what gets built.

  • Use data, but aren't beholden to it. You make data-driven decisions where you can, and you're not afraid to make the call when the data isn’t there.

  • Bring consistency and rhythm. You help give the team a rhythm for how we plan and ship, so everyone knows what’s happening and when.

  • Forward thinking with AI. You're all in on AI, you build with it and you tinker in your own time.

Nice to Have

  • ML systems experience, especially recommendation, search or matchmaking

  • Marketplace experience

  • RecTech or HRTech experience

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

Interview Process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

title: Graduate Tax Analyst
description:
Learn tax from scratch. Then help rebuild how it's done.

No prior tax knowledge needed. We'll teach you the tax and fund your professional qualification.

What you bring is the other half: SQL, code, and hands-on experience using AI workflows to turn large datasets into clear answers. Because tax, it turns out, is a data problem with deadlines.

And you'll join while the tax function is still being built, so the tools you make become part of how it runs.

 

The Job

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. Every new market and product line brings tax questions, and you'll help answer them.

  • Plan for what's next: work with our Director of Finance and tax specialists on tax planning for new markets and products, and build your own view of how tax works across the business.

  • Follow the data: map how tax data moves from our systems to our returns, and spot where it could be faster, more accurate or better controlled.

  • Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception.

  • Ship tools people use: build tax tools on live financial data, from first idea to everyday use.

  • Deliver the returns: work with our tax specialists on returns and reporting across our markets, on processes you helped improve.

 

Why you'll want it

A qualification, paid for. Learn tax on the job from specialists across multiple disciplines, with your professional qualification funded.

The whole function, not one corner. Planning, launches, processes and returns: you'll see how tax works across a high-growth fintech, start to finish.

Real outcomes, early. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you own real work early and take on more as soon as you're ready.

A CV with both halves. You'll come out knowing tax, and knowing how to build the AI-enabled systems behind it in a regulated business.

 

Is this you?

You have, or are on track for, a first-class degree in a numerate subject (or equivalent experience). You're graduating in 2026 or 2027, or you're up to two years into your career.

You write strong SQL plus Python or similar, and you've used AI workflows on large datasets in practice.

You think in systems, and you can explain technical work to people who don't write code.

And you're genuinely curious about tax, with the drive to qualify.

 

Never studied tax? That's the part we teach. Send your CV, even if it isn't polished yet.

About Deliveroo Editions

With a dash of hard-work, a sprinkle of teamwork and a whole dollop of creativity, we created “Editions” which is our ‘dark kitchens’ business. We have partnered with some fantastic restaurants such as Wagamama, Starbucks, Pho and Gourmet Burger Company to help further connect them with hungry customers.

Does this sound tasty to you? Take a look at our Kitchen Assistant role and apply below to join the Roo family.

About the role

The Cleaner / Site Associate role covers a wide range of tasks across the Editions site. You will ensure that the site is clean, support the wider operation of the site to ensure that our loyal customers receive their orders as quickly as possible from our trusted partners. 

Responsibilities will include:

  • You will report into the Site Manager and the site management team.

  • Ensuring that the cleanliness of the site is maintained to a high standard by cleaning as you go throughout the shift as well as regular deep cleaning of various equipment throughout the week

  • Cleaning communal areas, such as staff room, bathrooms, stock rooms, maintaining site health and safety standards at all times

  • Working with the management team to ensure a safe and clean site by participating in regularly checking

  • Supporting our partners by keeping kitchen equipment clean and ready for use throughout the shift with the pot wash

Who we are looking for

  • You radiate positivity!

  • You have a great attitude to work, you are driven and have willingness to learn

  • You are a team player, punctuality and reliability is your forte

  • You always go above and beyond, you’re looking to progress in your career

  • You can work autonomously but you LOVE working with a fantastic team and with our partners

  • You like to solve problems, making recommendations on how to improve daily tasks

  • Previous experience in a Kitchen Porter or Kitchen Cleaner role is a bonus, but don’t worry if you haven’t, if you have the right attitude and drive, we can train you.

What to expect from the interview process

  • Step 2: if your application is successful, you will receive an assessment from Maki People

  • Step 3: if you're successful following assessment, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to say hello and understand more about your experience

  • Step 4: if we decide to progress your application, you will be invited to an onsite interview with one of the site managers

  • Step 5: We'll come back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the outcome!

Why Deliveroo


Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. . We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace and Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing startups in an exciting space.

description:
Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Brighton - St Josephs Business Park (BN3)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Brighton team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.

What We Offer

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support or reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.

description:

As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach.   • Hands-on functional, acceptance and planned, risk-based exploratory testing of our native iOS and Android apps

  2. La team Customer Success, qui accompagne sur le long terme les copropriétés sur le modèle coopératif et les aide dans leurs problématiques complexes,

  3. La team Customer Onboarding (10 personnes) : qui organise la phase de transition, paramètre l’espace client, gère la reprise comptable, et guide le client dans sa nouvelle fonction de syndic. C’est cette équipe que tu rejoins.

Ce département est central chez Matera, et nécessite de bien communiquer et de se synchroniser avec les équipes Commerciale, et les équipes d’experts Juristes, Travaux, Comptables etc., afin de garantir une satisfaction client optimale !

En tant que "Customer Onboarding", ton rôle est d’accompagner les clients dans leur projet de changement de syndic, dans leur prise en main de l’outil Matera, et d'améliorer leur expérience et leur satisfaction dès leurs premiers mois avec nous. Tu reprends en main la relation client dès leur signature de contrat avec l’équipe Commerciale.

Concrètement, tes missions sont les suivantes :

title: CDI - Head of Finance (Paris)
description:
We are hiring a Head of Finance and to own the finance function end to end, reporting to the CFO: monthly close and reporting, budget and rolling business plan, board materials, cash, audits and the regulatory obligations of a syndic, across our French and German entities.

It is a hands-on role for someone who can do every job in the team and wants to shape the function as the company scales.

With our CFO focused on fundraising and strategic topics, you will be the day-to-day finance decision-maker, working directly with the CEO, the VPs and the German country manager. As Matera grows, including through acquisitions in France and Germany, there is scope to rapidly grow into a VP Finance role.

What you will do

1. Operational finance and business plan (70%) :

  • Own the monthly close of all entities (in France and Germany) and deliver the management reporting pack: P&L, cash, KPIs, reconciliation with the statutory accounts, reporting to investors and banks.

  • Own the annual budget, built with every team lead, and the business plan, updated every month after the close, for France and Germany.

  • Own cash: the cash forecast, collection from customers, bank loans and their covenants, financing files and data rooms.

  • Deliver the statutory audits in France and Germany and the annual accounts and filings of every entity, as well as the obligations specific to a property manager: the financial guarantee (garantie financière) that protects our clients' money, and the certifications of the funds we hold on their behalf (fonds mandants). You also cover the research tax credit (CIR) and tax.

2. Strategic topics (20%) :

  • Lead the finance team (4 people) and steer our external accountants and auditors on scope, calendar and fees.

  • Prepare the board deck and investor materials with the CFO, including for our 2027 fundraise, and bring a clear finance view to strategic decisions: acquisitions, growth versus capacity, cash allocation, pricing.

  • Drive our finance tools roadmap: selecting and rolling out an ERP (planned for late 2027), billing and payment tools, and automating data and reporting.

  • Pick up whatever else lands on finance: supplier negotiations, legal structure of our entities, equity events.

3. M&A (10%) : work with the other teams on financial analyses, billing, and the integration of the companies we acquire.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • The monthly close and reporting pack land on a fixed calendar in both countries, without escalation

  • Audits in France and Germany are signed on time and on fee; every entity's accounts are filed on time

  • Garantie financière and fonds mandants obligations are met with no gaps

  • The rolling business plan is the single reference for decisions, refreshed every month after close

  • The weekly cash forecast is trusted by the CEO and the board; collection has improved measurably

  • Every finance deliverable has a clear owner, and the German close runs locally

  • The ERP is selected and its implementation is on plan

What we offer

Benefits

  • Parental support: a gradual return at 80% for 4 weeks (paid at 100%), plus 5 extra days off per year when your child is sick.

  • Responsible commute leave: 1 extra paid day off per year (can be split into two half-days) to encourage low-carbon commuting.

  • Menstrual leave: 1 extra paid day off per month to manage painful periods.

  • Sport: access to Wellpass for affordable gym and sports.

  • Works council perks (Leeto): discounts on culture and leisure (cinema, museums, theme parks…).

  • Remote work: 2 days a week at the office.

  • Career support: weekly one-to-ones with your manager, 2 performance reviews a year, and an internal mobility policy.

  • A laptop and a work phone.

Practical information

  • Location: Paris 10th

  • Contract: permanent contract (CDI), full-time, cadre status on a forfait jours basis

  • Salary: €90k to €100k base, depending on experience

  • Start date: before July 2027


What we are looking for

You must have:

  • 7+ years in finance, including at least 2 years owning the close and audits of a multi-entity company, for example as Head of Finance, Finance Manager or Senior Financial Controller.

  • Hands-on experience of closing the books and running statutory audits in France: you know the French system (social charges, tax, statutory auditors).

  • Experience in a group with entities in other countries (not necessarily Germany).

  • You build and defend financial models (P&L, cash, headcount, churn) and can run a monthly business plan yourself.

  • You have managed a small team, and you still like doing some of the work yourself.

  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken.

You are:

  • Direct: you say when a number does not hold, including to the CEO.

  • Hands-on and structured: you turn open questions into plans with owners and deadlines.

  • Firm with suppliers: you manage auditors, accountants and vendors on scope, calendar and fees.

  • Autonomous and comfortable with change: you have worked in a growing company that needed structure.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with a German subsidiary or parent company, or speaking German.

  • Experience of acquisitions and their integration.

  • Experience in a regulated environment or with client funds (real estate, property management, fintech).

  • Experience of selecting or rolling out an ERP.

Our hiring process

1️⃣ A 30-minute phone call with Camille, our recruiter

2️⃣ A technical discussion with Krystal, our CFO, and Valent, our current Head of Finance (45 min, video call)

3️⃣ A case study to prepare and present to the CFO and Head Of Finance (45 min, video call)

4️⃣ A meeting with Raphaël, our CEO, and the team, at our office (1h)

5️⃣ Reference checks, then an offer

Good to know:

🕑 We do our best to get back to you quickly (within a week). Whether the answer is yes or no, you will receive an email from us, so remember to check your spam folder.

☝️ If you need any adjustments to take part in the interviews in the best conditions, let us know in your application or tell the recruitment team.

description:

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services.  We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The role 🔍

One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.

You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.

This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo, our Chief Product Officer.

How we work 🤖

We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.

We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.

We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.

What this means for you:

  • Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

  • Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

  • Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.

Team goals 🎯

We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.

Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Own the verification product (50%)

  • Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

  • Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

  • Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

  • Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

Drive adoption and revenue (30%)

  • Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

  • Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

  • Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

  • Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

  • Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

  • Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

  • Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.

Your goals ⚡

After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.

After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters.

After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor.

At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs).


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must.

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end.

  • Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute.

  • Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it.

  • A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis.

  • Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows.

  • Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on.

Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office.

Location: Paris

We'd love it if:

  • You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles.

  • You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation).

  • You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands.

  • You speak French.

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics.

  2. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why.

  3. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min).

  4. Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients.

  5. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: French start-up with employees across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, and Singapore, as well as users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development:

  • Custom onboarding plan per role

  • Internal and external group training

  • Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events:

  • Annual seminars: a global seminar in France and a teaminar in your country

  • Office socials: monthly apéro, goûter every Thursday, breakfast every other Tuesday, and a Children’s Christmas party on top of the employees’ Christmas party, etc.

  • Group activities: weekly yoga classes, monthly karaoke sessions, an indoor rock-climbing group, and participation in solidarity walks

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work:

  • 2-3 days in-office per week

  • Up to €500 reimbursed for remote work equipment

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT in 2026, with one taken for Solidarity Day

🍴 Meal vouchers (Tickets restaurants): Swile card with about 220€ per month

👀 Social & Economic Committee (Comité d’entreprise): Enjoy several benefits with HelloCSE

👩‍⚕️Health:

title: Head of Data - BeReal
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta.

Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 

Team

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life.

We are now an international team of 100+ people with 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Data is becoming increasingly central to how we build the product, understand our users and make decisions. We are looking for a Head of Data to own the function end to end and build the foundations required for the next stage of BeReal's growth.

 

Role

You will lead a team of Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts, reporting to the CEO and partnering closely with Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership role. BeReal deliberately operates with small, strong teams, and we are looking for someone who can define the direction while still going deep technically: reviewing architecture and data models, investigating quality issues, challenging pipelines, writing queries and building when necessary.

You should be the kind of leader who could design a modern data platform from scratch, scale it as the company grows, and make sure the people using it can trust what comes out of it.

 

What you'll own

  • Build and evolve the data platform. Own BeReal's data architecture end to end: ingestion, storage, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability and access. Build a platform that is simple, scalable, reliable and cost-efficient as both traffic and the number of data consumers grow.

  • Make data trustworthy. Raise the standard of data quality across the company through clear sources of truth, ownership, testing, monitoring, lineage and consistent metric definitions. Identify inconsistencies proactively and build systems that prevent them from recurring.

  • Data modeling and foundations. Define how our core entities, events and business concepts are represented across the warehouse. Build models that are reliable, understandable and maintainable as the product evolves.

  • Decisions, not dashboards. Turn large, complex user-level datasets into clear insights and recommendations that Product, Growth and leadership can act on. Help teams distinguish meaningful signals from noise and focus on the questions that matter.

  • Product analytics and experimentation. Own the methodology around instrumentation, Amplitude usage, event tracking, metric design and A/B testing. Ensure experiments are designed and interpreted rigorously and that product decisions are grounded in reliable data.

  • Make data self-service. Give Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership the tools and models they need to answer most questions independently, without creating a dependency on the Data team for every request.

  • AI-powered data access. Build or integrate practical ways for employees to interact with company data through AI (agents, bots, natural-language analytics and automated workflows) while maintaining strong standards around accuracy, permissions and governance.

  • Stakeholder management and prioritisation. Serve as the primary data partner to C-level executives and teams across Product, Growth and Engineering. Understand their needs, challenge requests when necessary, arbitrate between competing priorities and translate them into a coherent, high-impact data roadmap.

  • Technical leadership. Set strong engineering and analytics standards across the function. Review architecture, pipelines, models and queries, challenge technical choices and remain close enough to the work to intervene directly when needed.

  • Build the team. Lead, mentor and hire across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering and Data Analytics. Establish clear ownership, develop the people in the team and raise the technical and analytical bar.

     

Our Data Stack

  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Spanner.

  • Orchestration & transformation: Airflow, dbt.

  • Product analytics: Amplitude.

  • Visualisation & analytics: Hex, Tableau, internal tools.

This is our current stack, not a constraint. You will have significant latitude to simplify, rationalise and evolve it when there is a strong reason to do so.

 

Profile

  • 8+ years in data, with deep roots in Data or Analytics Engineering, or data architecture.

  • A hands-on builder: you’ve designed, built and run modern data platforms, ideally from scratch, and know how architecture evolves with scale.

  • Strong across the stack (warehousing, ingestion, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability), with strong SQL and enough depth to challenge production pipelines and models.

  • Deep data quality expertise: testing, monitoring, lineage, ownership and source-of-truth design.

  • Experience with high-volume, user-level data and with building self-service analytics for non-data teams.

  • Solid in experimentation and A/B testing. Mobile experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on with AI in data workflows (LLMs, agents, natural-language analytics), and a clear view of where it really adds value.

  • Strong stakeholder management and business judgment: you turn vague needs from Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership into clear metrics and a roadmap.

  • You’ve led data people or are ready to own a multidisciplinary team. This can be your first Head of Data role.

  • You ship fast, favour ownership and pragmatism over process, and explain complex topics clearly to anyone, founders included.

  • English is our working language. French is a plus.

 

Experience with Data Science or production Machine Learning is valuable but not a prerequisite for the role.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

title: Senior Computational Biologist
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines.

What you'll do

  • You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation.

  • Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny.

  • Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data

  • You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality figures, panels and supporting narrative, extending to posters, presentations or manuscripts where relevant.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who's comfortable working on complex biological questions across different therapeutic areas and drug development programs. You will own analysis and interpretation. The ideal candidate is creative, driven, fast, rigorous and autonomous.

You will be tackling complex internal R&D subjects that are actively slowing down cancer research. Your findings will impact the field and your work is expected to reach leading scientists via international conferences and peer-reviewed papers.

Must have

  • PhD in Computational Biology, bioengineering or any related field, 2 to 3 years analyzing complex biological data in a research or biotech setting is a plus.

  • Strong experience with molecular data: You analyse omics data (transcriptomics, genomics) within the context of cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening…

  • Interdisciplinary mindset: You quickly understand the context and framework within teams outside of your area of expertise. You are comfortable working in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, lab-based scientists and engineers.

  • Structured communication: You communicate research findings clearly through well-documented code, notebooks, written summaries, and presentations. For example, you can highlight key figures or publications where you drove the computational biology.

  • Real interest in cancer biology: You don't need to arrive as an expert: there's considerable depth around you and you'll absorb a great deal of it. But you should find the cancer biology genuinely interesting, and be the sort of person who goes the extra mile to understand what happens behind the result.

  • Strong programming skills: Python and fluency in the scientific coding stack.

  • Fluent in English: We are an interdisciplinary and multicultural team working in English.

Nice to have

  • Strong experience working with experimentalists.

  • Comfortable holding two or three analyses in parallel without losing track of either.

  • Experience in working with or analyzing data generated from sophisticated patient-derived cellular models (e.g. PDOs, PDXOs).

  • Industry experience where your analyses fed real go/no-go decisions.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be in a high-impact research role at the core of a distinctive oncology discovery platform, where you will have access to rare PDO multi-omics and functional datasets, and a dedicated engineering counterpart to turn your methods into durable building blocks.

  • Impact: participate and have ownership in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project at the early stage of a growing start-up, with the opportunity to shape it; a role where your technical expertise will have a tangible impact on patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. HR Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

Orakl Oncology is committed to diversity and equal opportunity. All qualified applications will be considered.
